verdict.rationale: Discord documents bot users that run inside servers: apps authenticate with a bot token and receive server events over the Gateway WebSocket, so a developer-built AI agent could sit in a channel as a bot member. The evidence shows no native AI agent, and it does not document mention-triggered replies; the developer must build and host the agent. Missing for 10: a first-party or turnkey AI agent member, documented mention-triggered participation (e.g. message/mention events), and hands-on corroboration of AI bots in channels.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned

citations.quote: Build bots and integrations on Discord
Build automated apps, commands, and integrations that run inside Discord servers.
The Gateway API lets apps open secure WebSocket connections with Discord to receive events about actions that take place in a server/guild
Using a bot token found on the Bot page within your app’s settings
